body:
Everytime I use this, the waterpipe gets put back in place properly, and I come to my senses on the floor. This time was insane, my apartment complex turned into a circle, so my depth perception changed to make this true. It was like the equidistance of a clock, and accordingly there was a person standing at each number, and I was speaking  to them as quickly as I could, out loud, by myself. I feel these may have been parts of me, or memories of me or others egos.
Peace.Duke
